description: This file defines a Blazor helper component class 'BlazorLayoutComponent' that extends 'LayoutComponentBase'. It manages refresh requests via a singleton '_refresh' object, subscribing to refresh events and providing a method to trigger UI updates.

classes.name: BlazorLayoutComponent
classes.description: A Blazor layout component that handles refresh requests through an event subscription, enabling dynamic UI update upon refresh events.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to the refresh event for handling refresh requests.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Public method to trigger a refresh request via the '_refresh' singleton.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Event handler method invoked when a refresh is requested; calls 'StateHasChanged' to update the UI.
